title: Engine diet: drop VideoHelperSuite (no workflow uses it)
description: No runtime workflow in comfy_workflows/ uses a VHS_ node, but Wan 2.2 I2V and Wan 5B still list ComfyUI-VideoHelperSuite as a dependency (models.js). Remove the dep + node_lock entry; prove it with one Wan I2V run on an isolated app. Part of the Engine diet umbrella.
